content.text: I fixed the bug in `solution/util.py`, and all 3 visible tests now pass. The problem was the placeholder-name regex `_NAME`, which used a lazy quantifier (`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*?`). With `re.match`, a lazy pattern stops as soon as it can, so it matched only the first character of each name. For example, in `{name}` it matched just `n`. The next character was then `a` instead of `}`, so `render` raised "malformed placeholder" for any name longer than one character. Changing it to the greedy `[A-Za-z0-9_]*` makes the regex match the whole name. I also read through `solution/core.py` and found nothing else that needed changing, so it is untouched.
